name: Chroman
description: The Chromans were a species of wormlike humanoids with smooth heads, smooth skin and webbed hands that were native to Chroma Zed. Their eyes were huge and round and their mouths were lipless. They burrowed into mountainsides and lived near trickling water to keep themselves moist.

data.name: Chroman
data.distinctions: Wormlike humanoids with smooth bodies and webbed hands
